Alright, I'm not going into super detail but here is the story:

Nickelback used to be a top rock band. Albums, hit songs, movie soundtracks, etc. Then their contact ran up with the current record company mid 2000s. This is where everything goes to shit.

The record company that signed Nickelback was known for their signing of heavy metal/screamo music. Fans of said record company saw that they signed a new band. They hopped on the bandwagon (bad joke, I'm sorry) and bought their newest album based on the sole reason that the record company had many other bands of similar interest, obviously excluding Nickelback.

This new album obviously upset a lot of people who bought solely on track record of the record company. This started the trend Nickelback Sucks. People, doing what they do best, copied this funny phrase. Repeating en masse "Nickelback Sucks.". (This phrase doesn't help sell albums.)

The small group of vocal idiots, I say this because they didn't do due diligence before buying a Nickelback album, got loud again when they were scheduled to play at the Superbowl in Detroit. People, again doing what they do best, got in mob mentality and repeated the "hate" for Nickelback.

Whether it's legitimate hate or not it's what a lot of people say so the phrase kinda sticks. That's where we are today. A decent band which has a lot of vocal/ironic/etc hate leading to their current insignificance.
